messages.subject: Issues with roxygen2 - function not exported to NAMESPACE even after using @export
parts: I am building a package and get an error, saying that a function is not an exported object of the package. In the R script, I have used @export tag to export the function, however when I roxigenise using document() or roxygen() the function is not exported to the NAMESPACE (the Rmd file for that function is created though)
